Violates FR-PERS-002 (session resume) and NFR-REL-001 (zero data loss)

recommended_actions: Read bug issue #125 for full reproduction steps and root cause hypothesis
Read ResumePrompt.tsx, App.tsx, persistenceStore.ts, and persistenceService.ts to trace the type mismatch
Identify exact fix approach to re-integrate ResumePrompt with correct type contracts
